# scamp_vm_classes (Data Source)

Retrieves list of available VM classes (CPU, memory configurations).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) List of VM classes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `cpu_cores` (Number) Number of vCPU cores.
- `cpu_max_usage` (Number) Maximum CPU usage percentage.
- `cpu_min_usage` (Number) Minimum CPU usage percentage.
- `description` (String) Description of the VM class.
- `id` (Number) ID of the VM class.
- `memory_mb` (Number) Memory in MB.
- `name` (String) Name of the VM class.
- `price_per_hour_millicents` (Number) Price per hour in millicents (10000 = 1 EUR).
